project.title: Metagenomic analysis of microbial diversity during anaerobic co-digestion of municipal solid waste and sewage sludge.
project.description: This project aims to identify and study the temporal changes in the microbial community during the anaerobic co-digestion of municipal solid waste and sewage sludge.
